describe: An interactable: what a player uses and strikes, as a component on a prop (the kinds usable and strikable: its prompt, what using it does, what a strike does) with its event and `add`, which stands one in a scene, with a unit test that a player before it sees its prompt and opens and shuts it with interact, and that a locked one stays shut until his punch bursts it open (PLAN.md WP 13.16).
id: the module's path, labs/<lab>/interactables/<name> (its component and its event are <name>, a word no other component has; a scene's setup stands one with <name>.add(w, { at })): labs/box/interactables/locker
next: make it do what its file comment says; stand one from a scene's setup ({{name}}.add(w, { at, yaw }), with physics: true, then addInteraction(w), and addMelee(w) or addWeapons(w) for its strikes); a page's HUD shows the player's interactor.prompt; then node x docs --write
